raw_text:
Absolutely! Here’s a 12-week general strength programme for your 42-year-old male client, post L4-L5 disc herniation, now asymptomatic but with clear restrictions: **no heavy spinal loading** (so no heavy squats, deadlifts, or overhead pressing) and **no loaded spinal flexion** (so avoid crunches, sit-ups, or any exercise that flexes the lumbar spine under load).

**Programme Goals:**
- Build general strength and muscle
- Improve core stability and posture
- Avoid spinal re-injury
- Encourage healthy movement patterns

**Programme Structure:**
- **Phases:** 3 phases (4 weeks each)
- **Sessions:** 3x/week (e.g., Mon/Wed/Fri)
- **Session Split:** Full-body each session, with exercise variation
- **Progression:** Gradual increase in load, reps, or sets as tolerated
- **Core:** Focus on anti-flexion, anti-extension, and anti-rotation
- **Mobility:** Daily mobility and stretching routine

---

## **Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Foundation & Movement Quality**

**Focus:** Movement patterns, core stability, light-moderate loads, perfect form

### **Weekly Structure**
- **Session A:** Push, Pull, Lower Body, Core
- **Session B:** Lower Body, Push, Pull, Core
- **Session C:** Pull, Lower Body, Push, Core

### **Sample Exercises**
**(All exercises: 2–3 sets, 10–15 reps, RPE 6–7/10)**

#### **Upper Body Push**
- Seated Machine Chest Press
- Dumbbell Floor Press (neutral grip)
- Cable Chest Press (standing, split stance)

#### **Upper Body Pull**
- Seated Row (neutral grip)
- Lat Pulldown (neutral or supinated grip)
- Chest-supported Dumbbell Row

#### **Lower Body**
- Leg Press (feet high, avoid deep flexion)
- Step-ups (low box, bodyweight or light dumbbells)
- Split Squat (bodyweight or light dumbbells, upright torso)
- Glute Bridge (bodyweight, progress to single-leg)

#### **Core (Anti-movement)**
- Dead Bug
- Pallof Press
- Bird Dog
- Side Plank

#### **Mobility (Daily)**
- Cat-cow
- Hip flexor stretch
- Thoracic rotation
- Hamstring stretch (lying, band-assisted)

---

## **Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength & Stability**

**Focus:** Increase load, introduce unilateral work, maintain strict form

### **Weekly Structure**
- **Session A:** Push, Pull, Lower Body, Core
- **Session B:** Lower Body, Push, Pull, Core
- **Session C:** Pull, Lower Body, Push, Core

### **Sample Exercises**
**(All exercises: 3 sets, 8–12 reps, RPE 7–8/10)**

#### **Upper Body Push**
- Machine Chest Press (increase load)
- Dumbbell Floor Press (progress weight)
- Landmine Press (standing, split stance)

#### **Upper Body Pull**
- Seated Row (increase load)
- Lat Pulldown (increase load)
- Single-arm Cable Row (standing, split stance)

#### **Lower Body**
- Leg Press (progress weight, avoid deep flexion)
- Bulgarian Split Squat (bodyweight or light dumbbells)
- Step-ups (increase box height or load)
- Hip Thrust (barbell or dumbbell, moderate load)

#### **Core (Anti-movement)**
- Pallof Press (increase band/cable resistance)
- Plank (progress to 45–60 sec holds)
- Bird Dog (add light ankle/wrist weights)
- Suitcase Carry (dumbbell, 20–30m per side)

#### **Mobility (Daily)**
- Continue as above, add thoracic extension over foam roller

---

## **Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Strength & Functional Integration**

**Focus:** Further load progression, more complex movement, functional strength

### **Weekly Structure**
- **Session A:** Push, Pull, Lower Body, Core
- **Session B:** Lower Body, Push, Pull, Core
- **Session C:** Pull, Lower Body, Push, Core

### **Sample Exercises**
**(All exercises: 3–4 sets, 6–10 reps, RPE 8/10)**

#### **Upper Body Push**
- Landmine Press (progress weight)
- Machine Chest Press (progress weight)
- Push-up (elevated or band-resisted as tolerated)

#### **Upper Body Pull**
- Chest-supported Row (progress weight)
- Lat Pulldown (progress weight)
- Single-arm Cable Row (progress weight)

#### **Lower Body**
- Leg Press (progress weight, avoid deep flexion)
- Bulgarian Split Squat (progress weight)
- Step-ups (progress weight)
- Hip Thrust (progress weight)

#### **Core (Anti-movement)**
- Pallof Press (heavy)
- Suitcase Carry (heavier, longer distance)
- Plank Variations (shoulder taps, feet elevated)
- Farmer’s Carry (double dumbbell, moderate distance)

#### **Mobility (Daily)**
- Continue as above, add dynamic warm-up before sessions

---

## **Sample Week (Phase 1, Week 1)**

**Session A**
- Machine Chest Press: 2x12
- Seated Row: 2x12
- Leg Press: 2x15
- Dead Bug: 2x10/side

**Session B**
- Step-up: 2x12/leg
- Dumbbell Floor Press: 2x12
- Lat Pulldown: 2x12
- Pallof Press: 2x10/side

**Session C**
- Chest-supported Row: 2x12
- Split Squat: 2x10/leg
- Cable Chest Press: 2x12
- Side Plank: 2x20s/side

---

## **Progression Guidelines**
- Increase weight or reps when all sets feel easy and form is perfect
- Prioritise quality over quantity
- If any discomfort in the lower back, regress the exercise or reduce load

---

## **General Notes**
- **Warm-up:** 5–10 min cardio + dynamic mobility before each session
- **Cool-down:** Gentle stretching, focus on hips, hamstrings, thoracic spine
- **Cardio:** Optional, 1–2x/week, low-impact (bike, elliptical, walking)
- **Recovery:** At least 1 rest day between sessions, sleep 7–8 hours/night

---

## **Key Restrictions**
- **No loaded spinal flexion:** No crunches, sit-ups, toes-to-bar, etc.
- **No heavy spinal loading:** No barbell squats, deadlifts, overhead barbell press, or similar
- **Maintain neutral spine:** Emphasise bracing and posture in all lifts

---

**Let me know if you want a week-by-week table or more detail on any phase!**
